vision.name: Super Shenron
vision.text:
([Trait:God] only. Once per game when this Ally enters play, you may Rejuvenate an Ally from your Banished Zone. You may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your other Allies would leave play. Draw that Ally at the bottom of your Life Deck instead. Search your discard pile for a Styled card and Rejuvenate it.
(Created by Jeff Sosa, OP3 TOP Champion)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP3); edge reads 'HERO/VILLAIN ALLY'; Trait badge G (gold); prints a design credit line
